contexts.text: a. This Mohammed... was entirely deserted.

A woman forsaken, and afflicted in spirit () = the Church which is not in truths, but is still in the affection or longing for them. A woman = the Church, which is said to be forsaken when not in truths... That it is to be established by the Lord, and delivered from spiritual captivity, is meant by, For a small moment have I forsaken thee, but with great compassions will I gather thee together again ().
The desertion and vastation of the Church is meant by the land being deserted and loathed ().
That all the truths of the Church are driven away, is signified by ... they have left him ().
Thou hast forsaken Jehovah () = aversion to being reformed by the Lord.
